script.cover_1: A colleague's tasks appear on your board. Nobody told you.
script.payoff: It happens when a team runs short, and asking who decided is fair.
script.caption: Quiet reassignments become permanent when nobody asks. Send this to the one who covers everyone's work.
script.situation: Can they hand you a colleague's work without telling you?
script.answer: It happens when a team runs short. Asking who decided and how long it lasts is fair.
script.reply_me: I see I now hold the vendor tasks. Who decided this, and until when should I cover them?
